name: Fiscal.ai
summary: Investment research platform combining financial data, analytics and conversational AI.
description: Fiscal.ai offers an investment research terminal with institutional financial data, analytics and AI chat, plus a data feed, API and MCP server to bring its data into other AI tools. Plans include a seven-day free trial at signup. Plans are offered for individuals and through sales.
